story.text: 광안리 밤바다, 모래 위에 나란히 앉아 있다. 저 멀리 광안대교 불빛이 물결 위에서 잘게 부서지며 흔들린다.
story.reading: gwang-an-ri bam-ba-da, mo-rae wi-e na-ran-hi anj-a it-da. jeo meol-li gwang-an-dae-gyo bul-bit-i mul-gyeol wi-e-seo jal-ge bu-seo-ji-myeo heun-deul-lin-da.
story.en: At Gwangalli's night beach, we sit side by side on the sand. Far off, the lights of Gwangan Bridge scatter and shimmer across the water.

story.text: "오늘은 진짜 '용기' 내야 된다, 내. 어제부터 계속 연습했다, 이 말."
story.reading: o-neul-eun jin-jja yong-gi nae-ya doen-da, nae. eo-je-bu-teo gye-sok yeon-seup-haet-da, i mal.
story.en: "Today I really have to gather my courage. I've been practicing this all since yesterday."

story.text: 그의 손이 무릎 위에서 자꾸 '떨린다'. 손깍지를 꼈다 풀었다 반복하며 좀처럼 입을 떼지 못한다.
story.reading: geu-ui son-i mu-reup wi-e-seo ja-kku tteol-lin-da. son-kkak-ji-reul kkyeot-da pul-eot-da ban-bok-ha-myeo jom-cheo-reom ib-eul tte-ji mot-han-da.
story.en: His hands keep trembling on his knees. He clasps and unclasps his fingers over and over, unable to bring himself to speak.

story.text: "장난 아니고, 진짜 '진심'으로 하는 말이다. 이거 하나는 믿어도."
story.reading: jang-nan a-ni-go, jin-jja jin-sim-eu-ro ha-neun mal-i-da. i-geo ha-na-neun mid-eo-do.
story.en: "This isn't a joke, I'm saying this from the bottom of my heart. You can believe at least this much."

story.text: "나 지금 '고백하는' 거다. 어색하고 촌스러버도 그냥 들어도. 사투리 섞여 나와도 이해해라."
story.reading: na ji-geum go-baek-ha-neun geo-da. eo-saek-ha-go chon-seu-reo-beo-do geu-nyang deul-eo-do. sa-tu-ri seok-yeo na-wa-do i-hae-hae-ra.
story.en: "I'm confessing to you right now. Even if it's awkward and unpolished, just listen. Bear with me if the dialect slips in."

story.text: "니 내 좋아하나? 아니, 이거 순서가 틀렸다. …내가 니 좋아한다고. 오래전부터, 그냥 친구 아니고. 이 말 하는데 와 이래 숨이 안 쉬어지노."
story.reading: ni nae jo-a-ha-na? a-ni, i-geo sun-seo-ga teul-lyeot-da. …nae-ga ni jo-a-han-da-go. o-rae-jeon-bu-teo, geu-nyang chin-gu a-ni-go. i mal ha-neun-de wa i-rae sum-i an swi-eo-ji-no.
story.en: "Do you like me? No wait, I've got the order backwards. …I'm saying I like you. Have, for a long time — not just as a friend. Why can't I even breathe right saying this."

story.text: 파도 소리마저 멀어질 만큼 심장이 '두근거린다'. 대답을 기다리는 그의 귀가 어느새 새빨갛다.
story.reading: pa-do so-ri-ma-jeo meol-eo-jil man-keum sim-jang-i du-geun-geo-rin-da. dae-dap-eul gi-da-ri-neun geu-ui gwi-ga eo-neu-sae sae-ppal-gat-da.
story.en: My heart is pounding so hard even the sound of the waves seems to fade away. Waiting for my answer, his ears have already turned bright red.

story.text: "단어는 다 봤제? 이번 대화 문제도 마지막까지 잘 풀어봐라."
story.reading: dan-eo-neun da bwat-je? i-beon dae-hwa mun-je-do ma-ji-mak-kka-ji jal pul-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: "Got a look at all the words? Give this conversation question a good try too, all the way to the end."

words.example_en: I was so nervous my hands trembled.
I could feel sincerity in his words.
He finally confessed his feelings to her.

words.meaning: For one's heart to pound, race
words.example_en: The moment I saw him, my heart started pounding.

sentences.en: He mustered courage and conveyed his feelings.
He confessed to her at the beach.
Waiting for his answer, my heart pounded.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 니 내 좋아하나? 아, 아니— 순서가 틀렸다. 내가 먼저다. 내가 니 좋아한다.
turns.reading: ni nae jo-a-ha-na? a, a-ni— sun-seo-ga teul-lyeot-da. nae-ga meon-jeo-da. nae-ga ni jo-a-han-da.
turns.en: Do you like me? Oh, no— that's the wrong order. I'm first. I like you.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: …That, right now — that's not a joke, is it?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 장난 아이다. 오래전부터 그랬다. 대답 안 해도 되니까 일단 듣기만 해라.
turns.reading: jang-nan a-i-da. o-rae-jeon-bu-teo geu-raet-da. dae-dap an hae-do doe-ni-kka il-dan deut-gi-man hae-ra.
turns.en: Not a joke. I've felt this way for a long time. You don't have to answer, just listen for now.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 듣고만 있으라니, 나도 하고 싶은 말 있는데.
turns.reading: deut-go-man iss-eu-ra-ni, na-do ha-go sip-eun mal it-neun-de.
turns.en: You want me to just listen? I have something I want to say too.

dialogues.question: 선우가 이 장면에서 전달하려는 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What is Sunwoo trying to convey in this scene?
dialogues.correct_answer: 오랫동안 품어온 진심을 용기 내어 고백하려는 것
options: 오랫동안 품어온 진심을 용기 내어 고백하려는 것
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 순서가 뒤엉킨 서툰 말투로도, 오래전부터 품어온 진심을 용기 내어 고백하고 있습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Me too… actually, I've felt that way for a long time too.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: …뭐라고? 다시 말해봐라, 잘못 들은 거 같다.
turns.reading: …mwo-ra-go? da-si mal-hae-bwa-ra, jal-mot deul-eun geo gat-da.
turns.en: …What did you say? Say it again, I think I misheard.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: You heard me just fine. I said I like you too.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 아, 안 되겠다, 심장 터지겠다 진짜. …됐다, 이제 우리 뭐라고 부르면 되노, 이 사이.
turns.reading: a, an doe-get-da, sim-jang teo-ji-get-da jin-jja. …dwaet-da, i-je u-ri mwo-ra-go bu-reu-myeon doe-no, i sa-i.
turns.en: Ah, I can't take this, my heart's really going to burst. …Okay, so what do we even call this now, this thing between us.

dialogues.question: 이 대화의 결과로 알 수 있는 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What can be concluded from the outcome of this conversation?
dialogues.correct_answer: 두 사람의 마음이 서로 통했다는 것
options: 두 사람의 마음이 서로 통했다는 것
dialogues.explanation: 승객도 같은 마음이었다고 답하면서, 두 사람의 진심이 마침내 서로 통하는 순간이 됩니다.
